dedupe_keys.name: atlas do seguro rural and sisser open data brazil federally subsidised rural insurance psr

description: Data on every rural insurance policy that received a federal premium subsidy in Brazil. The ministry page says the Atlas do Seguro Rural shows all subsidised rural insurance since 2006 with many breakdowns and is updated daily, with detailed data extractable from its open data tab and a methodological note on fields, and that SISSER offers the same subsidised insurance information since 2006 as a database for researchers, updated yearly, alongside statistical reports. Access is free. Coverage is Brazil. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-ND-3.0 (gov.br site-wide statement: all content of the site published under CC BY-ND 3.0 Unported). For simulation it gives insured crops, areas, values and claims by place and year, to study how droughts, frosts and floods turn into insured farm losses. A related catalogue record is the COACCH riverine flood insurance indicators. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
